label: Website quality
weak: Cluttered hierarchy, unclear focal point, difficult text or competing navigation.
solid: Readable type, coherent palette, usable hierarchy and a clear product example.
exceptional: Distinctive composition with strong mobile hierarchy, purposeful spatial storytelling and clear interaction states.

label: Conversion journey
weak: Unclear next step, generic signup or missing cost/coverage context.
solid: Clear discovery/download path with basic coverage and use instructions.
exceptional: Easy destination choice, specific preview, transparent cost and objections addressed before commitment.

label: Positioning
weak: Generic exploration promises or poorly separated audiences.
solid: Clear activity, audience and geographical scope.
exceptional: Specific visitor motivation and differentiated experience demonstrated by content.

label: Customer reputation
weak: Low-volume or materially mixed external app feedback.
solid: Positive verified storefront feedback at meaningful but limited volume.
exceptional: Strong rating at substantial volume with credible relevant feedback. Tiny perfect samples cannot score exceptionally.

label: Observed search visibility
weak: No owned-domain appearance in the eight-query sample (1); one query (2).
exceptional: Appearance in at least four queries (5); three queries score 4. This is sample presence, not market-wide SEO strength.

label: Independent authority
weak: Only weak or tangential independent attribution.
solid: Independently identifiable expertise or relevant recognition.
exceptional: Strong directly verified editorial or institutional recognition. Unverified logo walls remain Unknown.

label: Public product proof
weak: Offer claims with little actual content to inspect.
solid: Specific local tour/experience or usable example with basic details.
exceptional: Rich route/story examples, clear authorship and source context, maps or previews. This is delivery evidence, not revenue or conversion proof.
